description: Cross-binding conformance for array expression and equation forms that are relabellings of cells: `index` over a `reshape`, `transpose` or `concat` (esm-spec §4.3.5), which is an element of the operand at other subscripts; a positional `broadcast` of anonymous operands of different shapes (§4.3.4); and an arrayed definition `faq{i}(index(v, i)) ~ rhs` of an observed whose shape was never declared (§6.3.1), which defines the whole of `v` over the frame. Each document carries its own §6.6 `tests` block, so the authored expectation travels with the maths; the goldens are the Julia `interpreter`'s actuals for the same assertions.

scope_excluded.go: No simulator and no inline-test runner, so a tier that DRIVES one cannot be run here (API_SPEC.md §3, capability profiles). This is an exclusion from the CATEGORY, not from the rule.

tolerances.detail: The band between a producer's actual and the Julia-interpreter golden, separate from and tighter than each assertion's own §6.6.4 band. Every probe here integrates a constant tendency from a zero initial condition, or a linear decay, so an integrator contributes nothing near this floor.
